title: Video Editor
description:
**About Pravi:**




 At Pravi, we don’t just solve problems, we architect transformations. We partner with businesses, governments, and global institutions to design bold strategies, drive systemic change, and deliver measurable impact.
 



  





 The world is evolving at an unprecedented pace, demanding agility, innovation, and precision. Pravi exists to bridge the gap between vision and execution, helping organisations move from strategy to reality. Our expertise spans strategy consulting, story telling, strategic communication, digital transformation, and data\-led decision\-making, ensuring that our partners are not just future\-ready but future\-defining.
 



  





**Role Overview:**




 We are seeking a skilled and creative Video Editor for our full\-time, on\-site role located at our Gandhinagar Office. As a Video Editor, you will be responsible for editing video content, applying visual effects, conducting video color grading, and creating motion graphics. You will work directly with the creative team to edit and enhance video projects for various branding, marketing, and production purposes. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic team of industry professionals and contribute to impactful multimedia projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Edit and assemble raw video footage into engaging content for social media, websites, and campaigns
* Enhance videos using effects, transitions, music, voiceovers, graphics, and animations
* Collaborate with the campaign team to conceptualize video projects
* Ensure high\-quality output by maintaining attention to detail, colour correction, and audio balancing
* Stay updated with editing trends, social media video formats, and emerging tools
* Manage multiple projects and deliver on tight deadlines without compromising quality



  





**Qualifications:**



* 2\+ years of professional video editing experience
* Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Final Cut Pro
* Understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience engagement
* Basic knowledge of motion graphics is an advantage
* Creative mindset with a willingness to experiment with new editing styles

title: Trade Relationship Manager
description:
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 * Responsible for advancing the sales process, closing new business, and achieving/assisting in sales targets.
* Actively participate in the planning and execution of the company’s marketing activities, providing vital inputs based on interactions with prospects.
* Support and service existing customers by addressing their queries and resolving issues.


 DETAILED DESCRIPTION
 * Work on sales leads received through platform transactions, on\-ground sales personnel, and digital marketing sources.
* Establish connections with potential clients, explain product/service capabilities, and finalise sales presentations.
* Assist in the creation of Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
* Discuss commercial terms with potential clients.
* Address queries raised by prospective clients.
* Liaise internally for necessary inputs and approvals.
* Finalise contracts and close deals.
* Ensure receipt of subscription fees as per agreed terms.
* Assist Relationship Managers in the execution of their account and territory strategies.
* Support the company’s strategic and ongoing marketing and brand awareness campaigns.
* Drive prospect participation in internal and external events and webinars.
* Extend support to clients during the onboarding process.
* Respond to queries related to subscription plans and offerings.
* Log and escalate customer complaints appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
* Make regular calls to existing clients for proactive service and support.
* Resolve any issues faced by clients regarding subscription fee payments.
* Address client queries related to transaction processing by coordinating internally and following up with accurate responses.
* Guide customers on IT\-related issues on the 360tf platform or arrange expert support when required.
* Work closely with Relationship Managers to understand client requirements and deliver the best level of service to each customer segment.
* Handle queries raised by referral partners related to customer service.
* Systematically document customer interactions, turnaround times, and complaint resolutions.
* Produce regular MIS reports on customer complaints, turnaround time analysis, and resolution outcomes.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Job Description:** 




  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a proactive and organised Executive Assistant to support the setup and day\-to\-day operations of our new GIFT City branch. The role is a mix of Executive Assistance, Administration, and Branch Operations, ideal for someone who can take ownership and work independently in a growing setup.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Manage day\-to\-day branch administration and operational activities.
 



 • Provide administrative support to different departments.
 



 • Support the daily operations of the branch, including facilities and office\-related matters.
 



 • Coordinate office setup, facilities, vendors, supplies, and other requirements.
 



 • Handle policy issuance and maintain policy\-related data in internal systems.
 



 • Maintain accurate records, reports, and operational documentation.
 



 • Support senior management with meetings, documentation, coordination, and follow\-ups.
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
 



 • Assist in implementing and streamlining branch processes.
 



 • Handle ad\-hoc administrative and operational responsibilities as required.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 • 2\+ years of experience in Executive Assistant, Administration, Office Operations, or similar
 



 roles.
 



 • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 



 • Good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 • Strong coordination, follow\-up, and organisational skills.
 



 • Proactive approach with the ability to take ownership.
 



 • Good attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
 



 • Experience in a new office/setup environment will be an advantage.

 Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, or related fields will be preferred.
 



  





**Career Opportunity:** 




 The role is initially administrative and operational in nature. Based on the candidate’s interest,
 



 performance, and capabilities, there may be an opportunity to receive training and grow into an
 



 Underwriting role.

title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
description:
About Giffy Sign LLP
 
 Giffy Sign LLP is a wallpaper and wall mural manufacturing company operating under the brand
 **Giffywalls** 
 . We create made\-to\-order wallpapers and custom\-size wall murals for customers in India and international markets. We are looking for an SEO Executive who can help grow our organic visibility, rankings, and website traffic through effective SEO strategies.
 



  




 Job Overview
 
 We are looking for a result\-oriented
 **SEO Executive** 
 who understands search engine optimization, keyword research, technical SEO, content optimization, and link building. The candidate will be responsible for improving organic rankings and driving relevant traffic to the Giffywalls website.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Develop and execute on\-page and off\-page SEO strategies.
* Conduct keyword research and identify relevant search opportunities.
* Optimize website pages, product pages, category pages, blogs, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, and image alt texts.
* Perform technical SEO audits and identify website issues affecting search performance.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, clicks, impressions, and conversions.
* Work on internal linking and website structure optimization.
* Create and execute backlink\-building and outreach strategies.
* Identify relevant websites for guest posting and link\-building opportunities.
* Optimize content according to search intent and SEO best practices.
* Coordinate with the content and design teams for SEO requirements.
* Analyze competitors and identify opportunities for improving organic visibility.
* Work on local and international SEO strategies where required.
* Track SEO performance using tools such as Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Prepare regular SEO reports and share actionable insights.
* Stay updated with Google algorithm updates and current SEO practices.



  




 Required Skills
 * Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals.
* Good knowledge of keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Understanding of on\-page, off\-page, and technical SEO.
* Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Knowledge of SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of HTML and website structure.
* Good written communication and content optimization skills.
* Ability to analyze SEO data and identify actionable opportunities.
* Understanding of e\-commerce SEO is an advantage.
* Knowledge of international SEO is a plus.



  




 Preferred Candidate
 * 1–3 years of hands\-on SEO experience.
* Experience working with Shopify or other e\-commerce platforms is preferred.
* Candidates with experience in product/category\-page SEO will be preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a team.
* Candidates who are proactive, detail\-oriented, and willing to learn are encouraged to apply.



  




 What You Will Work On
 * E\-commerce SEO
* Product \& category page optimization
* Keyword research
* Technical SEO
* Content SEO
* Internal linking
* Competitor analysis
* Backlink building
* Guest posting \& outreach
* International SEO
* SEO reporting \& performance analysis



  




 Work Details
 
**Working Hours:** 
 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday
 



**2nd \& 4th Saturday:** 
 Off
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office
 



**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



  




 How to Apply
 
 Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with details of their previous SEO experience and relevant work/projects.

title: Lead Support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 IT Support Lead Engineer acts as
 **Level 3 support staff in the IT SD Support escalation matrix** 
 . As a lead engineer, you should have a solid technical background with Microsoft products, ticketing systems, security products like AV, DLP, Firewall, patch management. A problem\-solving attitude with an ability to train new hire and existing staff, can document troubleshooting and training KB articles, coaches’ team on technical issues. Can co\-ordinate with different cross functional team members, vendors for escalated issue resolution.
 



  





**Responsibilities and Duties** 




 1\. Act as L3 escalation point for unresolved cases and come up with a technical way ahead for challenging and unsolved IT SD Support cases.
 



 2\. Acts as technical mentor on floor to offer quick technical assistance to L1 and L2 engineers.
 



 3\. Trains new hires with IT SD technical training program.
 



 4\. Train, coach, and mentor L1/L2 Technical Support Engineers on technical aspects.
 



 5\. Acts as problem manager to come out with resolution for IT SD escalations and IT projects.
 



 6\. Demonstrable ability to think around issues and look at the wider picture in order to provide
 



 solutions through a variety of problem\-solving techniques.
 



 7\. Acts as technical SME on floor for ticket resolution.
 



 8\. Document organization SOP for various solutions implementation and maintenance related management.
 



 9\. Create internal and end user’s KB Articles.
 



 10\. Conduct technical awareness and troubleshooting trainings for existing staff.
 



 11\. Create SOP on recurring issues to capture troubleshooting steps.
 



 12\. Vendor management for product related deployment, upgrade, and escalation management.
 



 13\. Knowledge and understanding of best practice frameworks (such as ITIL, ISO20k).
 



  





**Desired skills \& competencies** 




 1\. Graduate in any discipline.
 



 2\. Expert in Microsoft products like desktop and server O.S., AD/Domain controller, WSUS, Bit locker, Exchange Server, O365\.
 



 3\. Sound knowledge of Endpoint security, DLP Products, WDS, SCCM.
 



 4\. Sound knowledge of windows OS, MS Severs, endpoints hardware and related troubleshooting.
 



 5\. At least 10 years \+ years of total IT experience with minimum 5 years of experience with IT Helpdesk / service desk in resolving technical escalation at level 2 and above profile.
 



 6\. Microsoft/O365 Certification.
 



 7\. Networking, security certification is an added advantage.
 



 8\. Drive, self\-motivation, and ability to work under own initiative.
 



 9\. Excellent customer Service Skills, Excellent problem\-solving skills.
 



 10\. Proactive and creative, Attention to detail, Excellent research skills.
 



 11\. Excellent English communication skill (both Written \& Verbal).
 



 12\. Customer\-centric
 



 13\. Problem Solver
 



 14\. Critical thinker
 



 15\. Can work under pressure
 



 16\. Multi\-tasking.
